ars_nouveau.enchanting_desc: Once you have acquired a jar of Echo and an Enchanting Apparatus, you may begin enchanting items. For more information, see the section on the Enchanting Apparatus.
ars_nouveau.fire_essence.tooltip: Can be used as a fuel echo.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_light: If cast on a block, a permanent light echo is created. May be amplified up to Glowstone brightness, or Dampened for a lower light level. When cast on yourself, you will receive night vision. When cast on other entities or with Sensitive, they will receive Night Vision and Glowing. If Sensitive, Glowing will use the spell color.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_redstone_si: Places a temporary block of redstone with configurable power and duration. Augment with Sensitive to set the target block as a power echo for itself and surrounding blocks. Dampen and Amplify will adjust the power from the base value of 10.
ars_nouveau.imbuement.crafting_started: Crafting %s. Add echo nearby to increase craft speed.
ars_nouveau.page.agronomic_sourcelink: The Agronomic Echolink generates echo from crop and tree growth within 15 blocks. Bonus echo is generated for magical plants such as Mageblooms, Echo Berry Bushes, and Archwood Saplings. Echo will be output from the Echolink to nearby jars within 5 blocks. Note: Bonemealing crops will not grant Echo.
ars_nouveau.page.alchemical_sourcelink: Generates echo by consuming potions from adjacent potion jars. The amount of echo varies per potion and is dependent on the complexity of the potion. Bonus echo is given for the length and level of the potion with multipliers for each effect a potion contains. Utilizing Wixies and Potion Melders is recommended for creating highly complex potions.
ars_nouveau.page.brazier_relay: Allows the users to bind a Ritual Brazier ritual to a new location. Multiple rituals can be connected to the same brazier relay. To connect, use the Dominion Wand on your Ritual Brazier, then the relay. Echo is consumed at the original braziers location. Can be bound within 15 blocks.
ars_nouveau.page.crystallizer1: The crystallizer provides a renewable echo of Echo Gems by condensing echo over time. The Crystallizer can work passively at a very slow rate, or it may be given echo from adjacent jars and create Echo Gems as a much faster rate. The Crystallizer may also be accessed by Hoppers and Starbuncles.
ars_nouveau.page.dominion_wand: A tool for configuring Echo Relays and automation entities. To set a transfer path, use the wand on the object that you would like to take echo from, and then use it on the block you would like to send echo to. For example: Echo Jar to Echo Relay, Echo Relay to Echo Relay, or Echo Relay to Echo Jar. To clear connections, sneak and use this wand on a relay. If you sneak-use it on the air it will switch to Strict mode, allowing to specify the side of the blocks to use.
ars_nouveau.page.magebloom_crop: A magically infused flower, Mageblooms provide additional echo to nearby Agronomic Echolinks as they grow and provide a echo of Magebloom Fiber. Mageblooms can also be used in crafting Potions of Spell Damage, increasing the damage of your spells.
ars_nouveau.page.mendosteen: A fruit that can be brewed into a Potion of Recovery, increases the amount of healing received from all sources.
ars_nouveau.page.mycelial_sourcelink: Generates a moderate amount of echo from nearby food, generating more for more nourishing food. Echo Berry food is worth far more than other mundane foods. Additionally, the Mycelial Echolink will convert Grass or Dirt in the 3x3 below it into Mycelium and will grow mushrooms around it given that the space is empty. The Echolink will also pull items from nearby pedestals.
ars_nouveau.page.potion_melder: Converts three doses of a potion from two Potion Jars and outputs a potion with the combined effects. Use the Dominion Wand from a Potion Jar to Melder to link a jar for consumption. Link two input potion jars to the melder. Then, use the wand on the Melder and then to a third jar to set the output. The Potion Melder requires echo per mix.
ars_nouveau.page.reactive2: To enchant an item with Reactive, place any item or armor in the apparatus. The spell parchment placed on the pedestal must be inscribed with a valid spell. See the Scribes Table for additional information. Reactive Enchantment also requires jars of echo near the Enchanting Apparatus. The first level enchantment requires approximately one third of a jar.
ars_nouveau.page.reactive3: To upgrade the enchantment, replace the reagent with any item that has an existing Reactive enchantment. The Tier 2 reactive enchantment requires an item with Reactive I, and the Tier 3 Reactive enchantment requires an item with Reactive II. Higher levels will require a significantly higher amount of echo nearby.
ars_nouveau.page.relay: Enables the transport of echo between Echo Jars and other Echo Relays. To pull echo from jars, use the Dominion Wand on the jar, and then on the relay. To send between relays or from a relay to a jar, use the wand on the relay and then the target you wish to send echo to. Relays may only reach up to 30 blocks away. To clear connections, sneak while using the Dominion Wand on the relay.
ars_nouveau.page.relay_collector: Operates similar to the Echo Relay, but will automatically take from jars it is not linked to within 5 blocks. See the instructions on the Echo Relay for use.
ars_nouveau.page.relay_deposit: Operates similar to the Echo Relay, but will deposit to jars it is not linked to within 5 blocks. See the instructions on the Echo Relay for use.
ars_nouveau.page.relay_splitter: Operates similar to the Echo Relay, but will support taking from and transferring to multiple jars at once. The splitter has a much larger through-put than the Echo Relay, and will split this throughput amongst all of its jars. See the instructions on the Echo Relay for use.
ars_nouveau.page.relay_warp: Operates similar to the Echo Relay: Splitter but can teleport echo an endless distance between other Warp relays. For distances beyond 30 blocks, there is a chance that some echo will be lost during warp.
ars_nouveau.page.runic_chalk: Runic chalk can be used to place permanent Runes on the ground that will cast spells on entities that walk over them. To give a rune a spell, inscribe spell parchment using the scribes table. Once the rune has cast the spell, it will become uncharged. An uncharged rune will charge itself from nearby echo jars. Using Runic Chalk on a temporary rune will convert it to a permanent one.
ars_nouveau.page.source_jar: Echo Jars store echo gathered from nearby Echolinks. Echo is used in glyphs and rituals by powering devices like the Imbuement Chamber and Enchanting Apparatus. Echo may be moved using a Echo Relay or by breaking and moving it. To use Echo in a jar, simply place the jar near your desired device. Echo Jars will provide a signal to Redstone Comparators based on their fill level.
ars_nouveau.page.starbuncle_shades: Using these on a Starbuncle will disable their ability to pick up items off the ground or pick Sourceberries. Wanding the starbuncle will drop the glasses.
ars_nouveau.page.vitalic_sourcelink: Generates a moderate amount of echo from nearby mob death and animal breeding. Additionally, the Vitalic Echolink will generate passive Echo from nearby baby animals and will accelerate their growth.
ars_nouveau.page1.basic_spell_turret: Turrets can be used to cast spells when given a redstone signal, functioning like a dispenser. Turrets will accept spells that use Touch and Projectile. Spells may be set using an inscribed piece of Spell Parchment. In order to cast spells, turrets will draw echo from nearby Echo Jars. Turrets may use Item Pickup and Place Block as long as an inventory is placed adjacent to this block.
ars_nouveau.page1.enchanting_apparatus: The Enchanting Apparatus utilizes pedestals and Echo for crafting. To use the Enchanting Apparatus, place any number of Arcane Pedestals within 3 blocks with their items. Once you have filled the pedestals, use the middle item on the Enchanting Apparatus block. The Enchanting Apparatus requires an Arcane Core beneath it in order to work.
ars_nouveau.page1.how_to_enchant: The Enchanting Apparatus may add new enchantments or upgrade existing ones by using Echo and items. To begin, select a level 1 enchantment and add its items to the pedestals. Place a jar of Echo nearby, and use the item you want to enchant on the apparatus. The apparatus may only apply enchantments that are valid to the item you have given it.
ars_nouveau.page1.imbuement_chamber: Imbues certain items with Echo to create new items. The primary way to obtain Echo Gems, amethyst and lapis may be used to create Echo Gems. The Imbuement Chamber will passively accumulate echo for recipes, or will draw from Echo Jars 2 block away. Some recipes require additional items placed in pedestals within 1 block of the Imbuement Chamber, such as Essences. Items in pedestals will not be consumed.
ars_nouveau.page1.new_glyphs: Accessing new spells will require a small amount of setup, resources, and base building. New spells can be learned by obtaining Glyphs. Glyphs are created using the Scribe's Table with Experience and items. Once you have obtained a glyph, simply use it to memorize the glyph. See the section on the Scribes Table for more information.
ars_nouveau.page1.obtaining_gems: To obtain Echo Gems, you must first build an Imbuement Chamber. An Imbuement Chamber imbues items inside it with Echo, and will convert them to a new item. To obtain a echo gem, place an Amethyst or Lapis inside your Imbuement Chamber and wait. Imbuement Chambers will consume echo from nearby Echo Jars to speed up any crafting. A Dowsing Rod can be used for finding Budding Amethyst early.
ars_nouveau.page1.source: Echo is a special resource that must be gathered using devices in the world. Echo is used for powering devices like the Imbuement Chamber and Enchanting Apparatus. To begin gathering Echo, you will need a Echo Jar and a Echolink.
ars_nouveau.page1.source_berry: A Echoberry Bush can be found in Taiga and Archwood Forest biomes, and produces Sourceberries. A Echoberry can be used to craft a Potion of Mana Regeneration or consumed as food. Starbuncles will automatically harvest fully grown Echo Berry Bushes, making them useful for early automation of the Agronomic Echolink. Echoberry foods will also grant Mana Regeneration.
ars_nouveau.page1.starting_automation: Spells may be used in Automation using Spell Turrets. Use these to create auto harvesters, tree farms, quarries, cake farms, glass factories, and more! For item transport, autocrafting, or resource generation, see the variety of magical entities that may be summoned using Charms.
ars_nouveau.page1.volcanic_sourcelink: The Volcanic Echolink generates Echo by consuming burnable items. Archwood logs will generate bonus Echo, with Blazing Archwood generating the most. As the Volcanic Echolink produces Echo, it also produces $(item)heat$(), used for spawning Lava Lilies and converting stone into lava. The Volcanic Echolink automatically outputs to nearby jars, starting with the one closest to it.
ars_nouveau.page1.warp_portal: Warp portals, like warp scrolls, provide a one-way teleport to any location, provided it is in the same dimension. To construct a Warp Portal, build a frame from Echostone or its variants in the shape of a rectangle and provide a full Echo Jar nearby. Then, throw a warp scroll with a written location into the frame. Given there is enough echo nearby, the portal will be created.
ars_nouveau.page1.wixie_charm: A Wixie can automatically craft items for you at the expense of echo. To obtain a Wixie Token, cast Dispel on a Witch while it is half health or less. Once you have obtained a Wixie Charm, use it on a Cauldron to summon your Wixie. A Wixie can be dyed Red, White, Black, Blue, or Green.
ars_nouveau.page1.world_generation: Several resources can spawn in the world, each with their own magical properties. Archwood trees come in several decorative variants and may be used to craft Casting Wands. Echo Berries, found in Taigas, are essential for crafting Mana Regeneration potions.
ars_nouveau.page2.basic_spell_turret: Enchanted Spell Turrets cast spells at half the echo cost compared to basic spell turrets.
ars_nouveau.page2.mob_jar: Many entities can be interacted with inside the jar and will continue to simulate while inside the jar. Some examples include: chickens will lay eggs, sheep can be sheared, cows can be milked, and some mobs like the Blaze will turn the jar into a light echo. Experiment with a variety of mobs to create aesthetic and functional farms. Drygmys will also treat the jar as if it were a normal entity in the area.
ars_nouveau.page2.performing_rituals: To activate your ritual, interact with the brazier with an empty hand. Once activated, your ritual can no longer be augmented and has been consumed permanently. If a ritual requires echo to operate, the brazier will pull from echo jars within 6 blocks. Information related to rituals and their requirements can be found in their respective entries.
ars_nouveau.page2.volcanic_sourcelink: Nearby Blazing Archwood items will be burned up in exchange for a chunk of Echo and a moderate amount of $(item)heat$(). The Volcanic Echolink will also take items from surrounding pedestals.
ars_nouveau.page2.warp_portal: Portals can be built horizontal or vertical, from 1x1 to 21x21 in size. Warping does not cost any echo after creation. Using a Dominion Wand on the portal will change the texture of the portal.
ars_nouveau.page3.starbuncle_charm: To summon a Starbuncle, use a Starbuncle charm on the ground. Summoned Starbuncles will pickup nearby items and can move items between inventories such as chests. Starbuncles will harvest fully grown Echo Berry bushes around it. A Starbuncle will drop its charm when Dispelled or when killed. You may dye them any color.
ars_nouveau.page3.volcanic_sourcelink: The Volcanic Echolink will occasionally convert Stone into Magma Blocks, and Magma Blocks into Lava, given that these blocks exist beneath it in its 3x3 area. This conversion is dependent on the amount of $(item)heat$() it has produced over time. The Volcanic Echolink will also spawn a Lava Lily adjacent to it given that there is nothing covering the lava. Lava Lilys may be harvested and used for decoration.
ars_nouveau.page3.whirlisprig_charm: To summon a Whirlisprig, use a Whirlisprig charm on any flower. Whirlisprigs consider their home to be 10 blocks in any direction from the flower. Whirlisprigs require echo nearby to operate, and will only generate items if there is a chest placed next to the flower. You can get your charm back by using Dispel on a Whirlisprig. They may be given orange, yellow, white, or green dye.
ars_nouveau.page3.wixie_charm: The Wixie will select the recipe for crafting based on the inventories nearby, you need not specify the exact materials for the recipe. For example, if you want to craft Sticks, the Wixie will mix and match planks from nearby chests in order to fulfill the recipe. Each craft requires a small amount of echo and will be drained from nearby Echo Jars. A redstone signal on the cauldron will stop crafting.
ars_nouveau.page5.drygmy_charm: Each Drygmy working around a henge contributes progress. Once maximum progress has been reached, the henge will generate items and experience gems and deposit them into adjacent chests. Each time this occurs, the henge will require Echo to recharge. The number of drops and experience gems is equal to the Drygmy happiness and experience value of the entities. To get started, place a chest and jar of Echo next to the Henge.
ars_nouveau.page6.wixie_charm: When using multiple Wixies, you may wish to lock a jar to a specific potion. Wixies will only output potion to jars that contain the same potion, or an unlocked empty potion. Each craft costs Echo. See the section on the Potion Jar for more information.
ars_nouveau.ritual_desc.ritual_conjure_i: Creates an island of sand and sandstone in a circle around the ritual, converting the area to Desert. The island will generate with a radius of 7 blocks. Augmenting the ritual with Echo Gems will increase the radius by 1 for each gem. Echo must be provided nearby as blocks are generated. Augmenting with Terracotta will create Badlands instead.

Creates an island of grass and dirt in a circle around the ritual, converting the area to Plains. Augmenting with a Frostaya with convert to Snow Plains. The island will generate with a radius of 7 blocks. Augmenting the ritual with Echo Gems will increase the radius by 1 for each gem. Echo must be provided nearby as blocks are generated.
ars_nouveau.ritual_desc.ritual_containme: Captures a nearby entity and places it into any nearby placed Containment Jars. After the first capture, this ritual requires additional echo to continue. Mobs and jars must be within 3 blocks of the brazier.
ars_nouveau.ritual_desc.ritual_disintegr: Destroys nearby monsters and converts them into Experience Gems worth twice as much experience. Monsters destroyed this way will not drop items. This ritual consumes echo each time a monster is destroyed.
ars_nouveau.ritual_desc.ritual_fertility: Periodically causes nearby animals to breed if possible. This ritual requires echo to operate, and will have no effect if there are twenty or more animals nearby.
ars_nouveau.ritual_desc.ritual_flight: Grants nearby players the Flight effect when they jump, allowing them to creatively fly for a short time. If the player is nearby, this ritual will refresh their flight buff. Each time this ritual grants or refreshes flight, it will expend echo from nearby jars.
ars_nouveau.ritual_desc.ritual_flowering: Populates the nearby area with flowers and grass. Augmenting with a echo gem will increase the radius by 1 for each gem. Augmenting with sand will replace flowers with Cactus and Dead Bushes.
ars_nouveau.ritual_desc.ritual_forestati: Places grown Oak and Birch trees, and applies bonemeal in a 7x7 (circular) area. Augmenting with a echo gem will increase the radius by 1 for each gem. Augmenting with a Brown Mushroom will convert the area to Podzol and spawn taiga resources. Augmenting with Glow Berries will spawn jungle resources.
ars_nouveau.ritual_desc.ritual_gravity: Grants nearby players the Gravity effect, forcing them to the ground for a short time. If the player is nearby, this ritual will refresh their gravity debuff. Each time this ritual grants or refreshes gravity, it will expend echo from nearby jars.
ars_nouveau.ritual_desc.ritual_harvest: Casts the Harvest effect on nearby crops. Consumes echo each time a set of crops are harvested. If an inventory is adjacent to the brazier, the items will be deposited in them before dropping on the ground.
ars_nouveau.ritual_desc.ritual_overgrowt: Occasionally bone meals blocks in the area around it. This ritual requires echo to operate. If augmented with a Bone Block, this ritual will instead force baby animals to grow faster.
ars_nouveau.ritual_desc.ritual_restorati: Heals nearby entities or harms undead over time. Additionally, Zombie Villagers will be instantly cured, and the resulting villager will offer discounts if a player was nearby. This ritual requires echo to operate.
ars_nouveau.ritual_desc.ritual_sanctuary: Denies hostile mobs from naturally spawning in a 32 block radius. Augment with rotten flesh to increase the radius by 1 each, up to 128. Costs echo once a minute if a spawn is denied.
ars_nouveau.source_desc: Echo can be used to power rituals, summons, and machines.
